title: Removable Items From Pots
description: A simple datapack that allows you to remove items from decorated pots by right clicking them.
body:
This is a lightweight datapack that adds the ability take out stored items from decorated pots by simply right clicking them instead of having to break them. 

I made this mainly because I was annoyed it wasn't a feature in vanilla since I thought it'd be cool for quickly accessing consumables like wheat or ender pearls without having to go through a whole container gui, and it's just fun.

Works perfectly like vanilla and shouldn't cause any lag at all. No further steps are required after dropping it in your datapack folder and it can be removed without any additional steps as well.
